model_output.verdict: A welder and fitter whose certifications, precision, and inspection record make the work easy to judge.
write_up: Your resume makes a strong case for Welder / Fitter work! It connects structural steel and pipe experience with the processes, certifications, and fit-up standards a recruiter needs to see.
The Riverfront Tower line is the model: it names the job, the inspections, and about 900 welds. Your current work comes first, with the pipe welding and certifications easy to find.

The shutdown line is the one place I'd add what you did, rather than just when you worked. Otherwise, your resume isn't likely to be what stands between you and a callback; how competitive a particular job is will matter too.
